name: Gamuda Berhad
overview: 2026年，Gamuda Berhad 就北霹雳水处理及输水基础设施项目与槟城售水安排签署的谅解备忘录（MOU）两度延期，Bulk Water Supply Agreement（BWSA）的签署期限最终延至2026年7月13日。公司同时推进股息再投资计划（DRP），并发行新股。其他业务板块在公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Gamuda Berhad extended its Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for the proposed water treatment and distribution infrastructure in Northern Perak and the sale of treated water to Penang twice, with the deadline for executing the Bulk Water Supply Agreement (BWSA) ultimately extended to 13 July 2026. The company also proceeded with its Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRP) and issued new shares. No specific developments were announced for the other business segments.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 就北霹雳水处理及输水基础设施项目及向槟城出售处理水事宜，将Bulk Water Supply Agreement的签署期限延长至2026年7月13日。
actions.text_en: Extended the deadline for execution of the Bulk Water Supply Agreement for the proposed water treatment and distribution infrastructure in Northern Perak and the sale of treated water to Penang to 13 July 2026.
